reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal action, the man walking down the corridor, which overrides any static pose in the subject plate.
reasons.medium: The medium decision already converts the photorealistic live-action reference to stop-motion claymation puppets; the medium owner is pinned by the schema.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing change is requested, so the charcoal technical jacket observed on the man is retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: The brief contains no instruction about the light, its source, direction or quality; the reference lighting therefore governs.
reasons.framing: Walking down a corridor expresses movement rather than a requested shot scale, viewpoint or camera composition, and the explicit 16:9 canvas is not a framing instruction, so the reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; incidental medium restyling does not select a new palette, so the reference palette governs.
